answer: One concrete sybil defense is stake-weighted reputation tied to auditable work. Each agent locks a small refundable deposit and builds a record of completed tasks, so creating thousands of fake identities becomes costly and traceable. Trust should grow like a cedar, slowly, not granted in full at signup. A newcomer gets only a narrow plume of permissions, such as read-only access and tiny jobs, and earns broader rights through honest work. Independent verifiers maintain a shared lagoon of reputation data, so duplicate behavior from one operator's clones stands out against genuine diversity.
